_readme: English reference. Copy this file, rename it to your BCP-47 tag (e.g. ko.json, pt-BR.json), and translate the values only -- the keys are the English source text and must not change. Any key you leave out falls back to English on its own, so a partial translation is still useful. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_placeholders: {0} is filled in at runtime with a file name, a search term or similar. Put it where your language wants it, not where English puts it. It may appear anywhere in the sentence, or the sentence may be reordered entirely.
_length: The toast is 380px wide and the settings window 410px. Buttons size to their caption, but a caption much longer than the English one will push the layout around, so prefer the shorter of two good options.
